item.title: Pritzker Warns AI Employment Shock Demands Aggressive State Action
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
Can government protect the working class from a 10% AI-driven unemployment shock? Illinois Gov. JB Pritzker dives into the high-stakes intersection of tech monopolies, data centers, and the new political realism.
[SPLIT] ⚡ State governments must shift from corporate collaborators to active protectors of working-class citizens against digital and infrastructural overreach. [SPLIT] ⚡ Bipartisan backlash against concentrated tech power spans data center expansions, strict privacy frameworks, and aggressive antitrust enforcement. item.title: Autonomous Swarms: The AI Agent Breaches Reshaping Cyber Defense
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
An anonymous hacker used an army of autonomous AI agents to breach over 100 enterprise websites, including industrial giants like John Deere and Cummins. We examine the operational reality of automated cyber warfare.
[SPLIT] ⚡ Targeted industrial heavyweights included John Deere, SharkNinja, and Cummins, though respective spokespersons reported varying degrees of containment and data exposure. [SPLIT] ⚡ The primary threat actor executed these sophisticated intrusion tactics using fewer than 100 Chinese characters of prompt direction, with successful breaches taking approximately 23 hours.
